_comment: Switching-regime scenario for sub-project A. Target cruises at constant velocity (2.5 m/s) for the first 40 frames, then transitions to drag-coast (k=0.5) for frames 40-80. Trajectory: 1.0m at frame 0 → 6.0m at frame 40 → ~8.5m at frame 79 (stays inside the ~9.6m unambiguous range). The IMM-{CV, drag-EKF} tracker is the headline deliverable — its mode probabilities should be CV-dominant for frames 0-40 and drag-EKF-dominant for frames 40-80. CV-only (algorithm=kf) will drift positionally in the drag phase; drag-EKF-only (algorithm=ekf) will drift in the CV phase. Only IMM tracks both regimes.
